name: SP-17 Demolition Droid
description: The SP-17 Demolition Droid was a model of demolition probe droid used by the the Shroud, a freelance spy active during the Galactic War. Designed to self-destruct and injure enemies with the detonation, SP-17 Demolition Droids were among the forces that defended the Shroud's factory on the moon Nar Shaddaa.
